title: Atrof-muhit va ekologiya
goal_uz: Dars oxirida atrof-muhit lug‘atidan foydalanasiz, muammolar va yechimlarni tasvirlaysiz, should va must bilan harakatga chaqirasiz, sabab-natija bog‘lovchilarini to‘g‘ri qo‘llaysiz va uchta ekologik muammo hamda yechimlarini ingliz tilida taqdim eta olasiz.

scenes.title: Atrof-muhit va ekologiya
board: problems · solutions · should / must · cause and effect
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda sog‘lom turmush tarzi haqida gaplashdik, maslahat berishni mashq qildik. Bugun sayyoramizning sog‘ligi haqida: atrof-muhit va ekologiya. Avval lug‘atni o‘rganamiz, keyin muammolar va ularning yechimlarini tasvirlaymiz, “should” va “must” bilan harakatga chaqirishni mashq qilamiz hamda sabab va natijani bog‘laymiz. Dars oxirida uchta ekologik muammo va ularning yechimini ingliz tilida tushuntira olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we talked about healthy living. Today we're talking about the environment. You'll learn the key words, describe problems and solutions, say what people should and must do, and link causes with effects.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar sog‘lom turmush tarzi haqida gaplashdik. Bugun atrof-muhit haqida gaplashamiz. Asosiy so‘zlarni o‘rganasiz, muammolar va yechimlarni tasvirlaysiz, odamlar nima qilishi kerakligini aytasiz va sabab bilan natijani bog‘laysiz.

scenes.title: Tabiat va iqlim
board: the climate · the planet · an ecosystem

examples.t: We must protect the environment.
Many animals lose their habitat.

scenes.say_native: Avval asosiy so‘zlar. “The environment” — atrof-muhit, “nature” — tabiat, “wildlife” — yovvoyi tabiat. “The climate” — iqlim, “the planet” — sayyora, “an ecosystem” — ekotizim. “Habitat” — hayvon yashaydigan tabiiy muhit. “Fossil fuels” — qazilma yoqilg‘i: ko‘mir, neft va gaz. Diqqat: “environment” so‘zini ikkita “n”
scenes.say: Nature and wildlife are part of the environment. When a forest disappears, animals lose their habitat. Burning fossil fuels such as coal, oil and gas also changes the climate of our planet.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiat va yovvoyi hayot atrof-muhitning bir qismi. O‘rmon yo‘qolsa, hayvonlar yashash joyini yo‘qotadi. Ko‘mir, neft va gaz kabi qazilma yoqilg‘ini yoqish sayyoramiz iqlimini ham o‘zgartiradi.

scenes.title: Muammolar lug‘ati
board: climate change · global warming · greenhouse gases

examples.t: Deforestation destroys animal habitats.
examples.uz: O‘rmonlarning kesilishi hayvonlar yashash joyini yo‘q qiladi.

examples.t: Some species are in danger of extinction.
examples.uz: Ba’zi turlar yo‘qolib ketish xavfi ostida.

scenes.say_native: Endi muammolar. “Climate change” — iqlim o‘zgarishi, “global warming” — global isish. “Greenhouse gases”, masalan karbonat angidrid, issiqlikni atmosferada ushlab qoladi. “Air pollution” — havoning ifloslanishi, “litter” — yerga tashlangan chiqindi, “waste” — chiqindi. “Deforestation” — o‘rmonlarni kesish, “drought”
scenes.say: Climate change and global warming are serious problems. Air pollution, litter and plastic waste harm nature.
scenes.say_uz: Iqlim o‘zgarishi va global isish jiddiy muammolar. Havoning ifloslanishi, tashlandiq chiqindi va plastik chiqindi tabiatga zarar yetkazadi.

scenes.title: Yechimlar lug‘ati
board: plant trees · protect · use public transport

examples.t: We should reduce, reuse and recycle.
examples.uz: Biz kamaytirishimiz, qayta ishlatishimiz va qayta ishlashimiz kerak.

examples.t: Solar and wind power are renewable energy.
examples.uz: Quyosh va shamol energiyasi qayta tiklanuvchi energiya.

scenes.say_native: Endi yechimlar. Mashhur uchlik: “reduce” — kamaytirmoq, “reuse” — qayta ishlatmoq, “recycle” — qayta ishlamoq. “Renewable energy” — qayta tiklanuvchi energiya: quyosh, ya’ni “solar”, va shamol, ya’ni “wind”. “Save energy” — energiya tejamoq, “plant trees” — daraxt ekmoq, “protect” — himoya qilmoq. “Public transport”
scenes.say: We can reduce waste, reuse bags and bottles, and recycle paper and glass. Governments should invest in renewable energy such as solar and wind power.
scenes.say_uz: Biz chiqindini kamaytirishimiz, sumka va shishalarni qayta ishlatishimiz, qog‘oz va oynani qayta ishlashimiz mumkin. Hukumatlar quyosh va shamol kabi qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaga sarmoya kiritishi kerak.

scenes.title: Frazali fe’llar: ekologiya
board: throw away · use up · run out of
give off (gas) · switch off · turn down

examples.t: We throw away too much food.
Cars give off harmful gases.

scenes.say_native: Ekologiya mavzusida frazali fe’llar juda ko‘p. “Throw away” — tashlab yubormoq. “Use up” — butunlay sarflab tugatmoq, “run out of” — tugab qolmoq: “We are running out of oil”. “Cut down” — daraxtni kesmoq, “cut down on” — kamaytirmoq, ular o‘xshash, lekin ma’nosi boshqa. “Give off” — chiqarmoq, “switch off”
scenes.say: We throw away too much food, and we're running out of some natural resources. Please cut down on plastic and switch off the lights. Factories give off gases, and people cut down forests.
scenes.say_uz: Biz juda ko‘p ovqatni tashlaymiz va ba’zi tabiiy resurslarimiz tugab bormoqda. Plastikni kamaytiring va chiroqlarni o‘chiring. Zavodlar gazlar chiqaradi va odamlar o‘rmonlarni kesadi.

scenes.title: Lug‘at va artikl xatolari
board: ✗ the nature / the pollution (umumiy) → ✓ nature / pollution
✗ throw rubbish to the bin → ✓ in / into the bin
✗ rubbishes / a lot of wastes → ✓ rubbish / waste
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: umumiy tushunchalar bilan “the” ishlatish. “Nature is beautiful”, “Pollution is a problem” deymiz, “the” kerak emas. Ikkinchisi: “throw to the bin”. O‘zbekcha “...ga tashlamoq” ta’sirida shunday deymiz, ingliz tilida “into the bin” yoki “in the bin”. Uchinchisi: “rubbish”, “waste”, “litter”
scenes.say: Nature is beautiful, and pollution is a problem. We don't say the nature. Put your rubbish in the bin, and remember that rubbish has no plural.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiat go‘zal, ifloslanish esa muammo. The nature demaymiz. Chiqindingizni qutiga tashlang va rubbish ko‘plik shaklida bo‘lmasligini eslang.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang
board: recycle · give off · run out of · cut down on
3) We will ___ oil one day. 4) Please ___ plastic.
scenes.say_native: Tepada to‘rtta ibora bor: recycle, give off, run out of va cut down on. To‘rtta gapga mosini tanlang. Birinchi gap plastik shishalar haqida, ikkinchisi mashinalar haqida, uchinchisi neft tugab qolishi haqida, to‘rtinchisi plastikni kamaytirish haqida. Gaplarni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: we should what plastic bottles? Number two: cars what harmful gases? Number three: we will what oil one day? Number four: please what plastic?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: biz plastik shishalarni nima qilishimiz kerak? Ikkinchi: mashinalar zararli gazlarni nima qiladi? Uchinchi: bir kun biz neftni nima qilamiz? To‘rtinchi: iltimos, plastikni nima qiling?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “We should recycle plastic bottles”. Ikkinchi: “Cars give off harmful gases”. Uchinchi: “We will run out of oil one day”. To‘rtinchi: “Please cut down on plastic”. Bu yerda ikkinchi va to‘rtinchi ibora uch so‘zdan iborat ekaniga e’tibor bering: “cut down on” da “on” qo‘shimchasi ma’noni o‘zgartiradi.
scenes.say: We should recycle plastic bottles. Cars give off harmful gases. We will run out of oil one day. Please cut down on plastic.
scenes.say_uz: Biz plastik shishalarni qayta ishlashimiz kerak. Mashinalar zararli gazlar chiqaradi. Bir kun neftimiz tugaydi. Iltimos, plastikni kamaytiring.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘uli bo‘g‘inlar
scenes.say_native: Endi talaffuz. “Environment” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “en-VI-ron-ment”, to‘rtinchi bo‘g‘in esa deyarli eshitilmaydi. “Pollution” da urg‘u “-tion” dan oldingi bo‘g‘inda: “pol-LU-tion”, unli uzun. “Recycle” da urg‘u “cy” da: “ree-SY-kl”. “Endangered” da urg‘u “dan” da: “en-DAN-jerd”. O‘zbek tilida urg‘u ko‘pincha oxirgi bo‘g‘inda bo‘ladi, ingliz tilida esa bunday emas, shuning uchun har bir so‘zni urg‘usi bilan yodlang.
scenes.say: Environment. Pollution. Recycle. Endangered. Listen to the strong syllable in each word.
scenes.say_uz: Environment. Pollution. Recycle. Endangered. Har bir so‘zdagi urg‘uli bo‘g‘inga quloq soling.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Har bir so‘zni ikki marta baland ovozda ayting. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni kuchliroq, uzunroq va balandroq talaffuz qiling. “Environment” va “pollution” bilan boshlang, keyin “recycle” va “endangered” ni ayting. Qaysi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u tushishini oldingi sahnadan eslang. Agar xato qilsangiz, to‘xtamang, yana bir marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Environment. Pollution. Recycle. Endangered. Say each one twice.
scenes.say_uz: Environment. Pollution. Recycle. Endangered. Har birini ikki marta ayting.

scenes.title: Urg‘u javoblari
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri variantlar: enVIronment, polLUtion, reCYcle, enDANgered. Agar “environMENT” yoki “POLlution” deb aytgan bo‘lsangiz, hech qisi yo‘q, bu juda keng tarqalgan xato. Eslab qoling: “-tion” bilan tugaydigan so‘zlarda urg‘u qo‘shimchadan oldingi bo‘g‘inga tushadi. Yangi so‘zni lug‘atdan o‘rganayotganda IPA dagi urg‘u belgisiga qarang, u urg‘uli bo‘g‘in oldida turadi.
scenes.say: Environment. Pollution. Recycle. Endangered. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Environment. Pollution. Recycle. Endangered. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Muammoni tasvirlash
board: One serious problem is … · It is caused by …
Sea levels have risen · Ice is melting

examples.t: Ice is melting faster than before.
The Earth has become warmer.

scenes.say_native: Muammoni tasvirlashda aniq qoliplar kerak. “The main problem is that…” — asosiy muammo shuki. “One serious problem is…” — jiddiy muammolardan biri. Sababni “It is caused by…” bilan aytamiz. Hozir davom etayotgan o‘zgarishlar uchun hozirgi davomli zamon: “Ice is melting”. Hozirgi vaqtga ta’sir qiluvchi o‘zgarish uchun hozirgi tugallangan zamon: “The Earth has become warmer”, “Sea levels have risen”.
scenes.say: The main problem is that the Earth is getting warmer. Ice is melting, and sea levels have risen. This is caused by gases from cars, factories and power stations.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy muammo shuki, Yer isib bormoqda. Muz erimoqda va dengiz sathi ko‘tarildi. Bunga mashinalar, zavodlar va elektr stansiyalari gazlari sabab.

scenes.title: Yechim taklif qilish
board: The best way to reduce … is to …

examples.t: One solution is to use more renewable energy.
examples.uz: Yechimlardan biri qayta tiklanuvchi energiyadan ko‘proq foydalanish.

examples.t: If we recycle more, we will create less waste.
examples.uz: Agar ko‘proq qayta ishlasak, kamroq chiqindi hosil qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Yechim aytishda ham tayyor qoliplar bor. “One solution is to use more renewable energy” — bu yerda “is” dan keyin “to” bilan fe’l keladi. “The best way to reduce pollution is to…” — kuchli tuzilma. Shart gapi: “If we recycle more, we will create less waste”; “if” dan keyin hozirgi oddiy zamon, natijada “will”.
scenes.say: One solution is to use more renewable energy. The best way to reduce waste is to recycle. If we use public transport, we will create less pollution.
scenes.say_uz: Yechimlardan biri qayta tiklanuvchi energiyadan ko‘proq foydalanish. Chiqindini kamaytirishning eng yaxshi yo‘li qayta ishlash. Agar jamoat transportidan foydalansak, kamroq ifloslanish hosil qilamiz.

scenes.title: Britaniya va Amerika so‘zlari
board: petrol (BrE) / gas (AmE) · carrier bag / plastic bag

examples.t: Put your rubbish in the bin.
Petrol prices are rising.

scenes.say_native: Ekologiya mavzusida Britaniya va Amerika ingliz tilida bir nechta farq bor. Britaniyada “rubbish” va “bin”, Amerikada “trash” yoki “garbage” va “trash can”. Britaniyada benzin “petrol”, Amerikada “gas”, bu “gasoline” ning qisqartmasi, tabiiy gaz bilan adashtirmang. Plastik paket Britaniyada “carrier bag”
scenes.say: In Britain, you put rubbish in the bin and fill your car with petrol. In America, you put trash in the trash can and fill your car with gas.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniyada chiqindini qutiga tashlaysiz va mashinangizga benzin quyasiz. Amerikada trashni trash can ga tashlaysiz va mashinangizga gas quyasiz.

scenes.title: Muammo va yechim xatolari
board: ✗ the solution of the problem → ✓ the solution to the problem
✗ The best way is reduce → ✓ is to reduce
✗ Pollution cause illness → ✓ Pollution causes illness
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “solution of the problem”. O‘zbekcha “muammoning yechimi” ta’sirida “of” deymiz, to‘g‘risi “solution to the problem”. Ikkinchisi: “The best way is reduce”. “Is” dan keyin “to” bilan fe’l kerak: “is to reduce”. Uchinchisi: “Pollution cause illness”. “Pollution” — birlikdagi sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun fe’lga “-s”
scenes.say: The solution to this problem is simple. The best way to help is to recycle. And pollution causes illness, so we must act.
scenes.say_uz: Bu muammoning yechimi oddiy. Yordam berishning eng yaxshi yo‘li qayta ishlash. Ifloslanish kasallik keltirib chiqaradi, shuning uchun harakat qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Muammo va yechimni bog‘lang
board: 1) Too much plastic → One solution is …
2) Air pollution → The best way … is …
3) Forests disappear → If we …, we will …
scenes.say_native: Uchta muammo uchun yechim ayting. Birinchi: juda ko‘p plastik; “One solution is to…” bilan boshlang. Ikkinchi: havoning ifloslanishi; “The best way to reduce it is to…” deng. Uchinchi: o‘rmonlar yo‘qolmoqda; “If we…, we will…” tuzilmasidan foydalaning. Baland ovozda to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Too much plastic. Air pollution. Forests are disappearing. Give one solution for each problem.
scenes.say_uz: Juda ko‘p plastik. Havoning ifloslanishi. O‘rmonlar yo‘qolmoqda. Har bir muammo uchun bitta yechim ayting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy yechimlar
board: 1) One solution is to use fewer plastic bags.
2) The best way to reduce it is to use public transport.
3) If we plant more trees, we will protect forests.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: “One solution is to use fewer plastic bags”. Ikkinchi: “The best way to reduce air pollution is to use public transport”. Uchinchi: “If we plant more trees, we will protect forests”. Sizning yechimingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, bu yaxshi. Muhimi: “is to” dan keyin fe’l, “if”
scenes.say: One solution is to use fewer plastic bags. The best way to reduce air pollution is to use public transport. If we plant more trees, we will protect forests.
scenes.say_uz: Yechimlardan biri kamroq plastik paket ishlatish. Havoning ifloslanishini kamaytirishning eng yaxshi yo‘li jamoat transportidan foydalanish. Agar ko‘proq daraxt eksak, o‘rmonlarni himoya qilamiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash: qo‘shnilar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Ikki qo‘shni, Tom va Anna, uy oldidagi chiqindi qutilari haqida gaplashmoqda. Tom chiqindini ajratish juda qiyin deb o‘ylaydi, Anna esa unga yordam bermoqchi. Tinglang va e’tibor bering: Tomning muammosi nima, Anna qanday maslahat beradi va Tom oxirida nima qilishga va’da beradi.
scenes.say: Tom: I never know which bin to use. Anna: Well, the green one is for paper and the blue one is for plastic. Tom: But it takes so much time! Anna: You should put a small box in your kitchen. If you separate rubbish every day, it won't take long. Tom: OK, I'll try. We must do something!
scenes.say_uz: Tom: Qaysi qutiga tashlashni hech bilmayman. Anna: Yashil quti qog‘oz uchun, ko‘k quti plastik uchun. Tom: Lekin bu juda ko‘p vaqt oladi! Anna: Oshxonangizga kichik quti qo‘yishingiz kerak. Agar har kuni chiqindini ajratsangiz, ko‘p vaqt ketmaydi. Tom: Yaxshi, urinib ko‘raman. Biz nimadir qilishimiz kerak!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Tom nimani bilmaydi? Ikkinchi: plastik uchun qaysi rangdagi quti? Uchinchi: Anna oshxonada nima qilishni maslahat beradi? To‘liq gap bilan ayting, masalan “Anna says that Tom should…” deb boshlang.
scenes.say: What doesn't Tom know? Which bin is for plastic? What does Anna suggest?
scenes.say_uz: Tom nimani bilmaydi? Plastik uchun qaysi quti? Anna nimani maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari: qo‘shnilar
board: 1) He doesn't know which bin to use.
3) A small box in the kitchen.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Tom qaysi qutidan foydalanishni bilmaydi, “which bin to use”. Ikkinchi: plastik uchun ko‘k quti. Uchinchi: Anna oshxonaga kichik quti qo‘yishni maslahat beradi, chunki shunda ajratish osonlashadi. E’tibor bering, Anna maslahatni “You should…” bilan berdi, Tom esa oxirida “We must do something”
scenes.say: Tom doesn't know which bin to use. The plastic bin is blue. Anna suggests putting a small box in the kitchen.
scenes.say_uz: Tom qaysi qutidan foydalanishni bilmaydi. Plastik quti ko‘k. Anna oshxonaga kichik quti qo‘yishni taklif qiladi.

scenes.title: Should va ought to: maslahat
board: Should we …? What should we do?

examples.t: We should plant more trees.
People shouldn't waste water.

scenes.say_native: Endi “should” va “must”. “Should” va “ought to” — maslahat yoki fikr: “We should plant more trees”. Ularning kuchi o‘rtacha: “yaxshi bo‘lardi, kerak”. Ikkalasidan keyin “to” siz fe’l keladi, faqat “ought” dan keyin “to” bor: “ought to”. Inkor — “shouldn’t”. Savolda “should” gap boshiga chiqadi: “What should we do?”.
scenes.say: We should plant more trees, and we ought to use less water. People shouldn't waste energy. What should we do first?
scenes.say_uz: Biz ko‘proq daraxt ekishimiz va kamroq suv ishlatishimiz kerak. Odamlar energiyani isrof qilmasligi kerak. Birinchi nima qilishimiz kerak?

scenes.title: Must, mustn't va have to
board: mustn't = taqiqlangan · don't have to = shart emas

examples.t: You mustn't drop litter. It's illegal.
examples.uz: Chiqindi tashlash mumkin emas. Bu noqonuniy.

examples.t: You don't have to buy a car. You can cycle.
examples.uz: Mashina sotib olishingiz shart emas. Velosiped haydashingiz mumkin.

scenes.say_native: “Must” — kuchli majburiyat, ko‘pincha so‘zlovchining o‘z fikri: “We must act now”. “Have to” — qoida yoki tashqi majburiyat: “In Britain, you have to pay for plastic bags in shops”. Eng muhim farq inkorda. “Mustn’t” — taqiqlangan: “You mustn’t drop litter”. “Don’t have to” — shart emas: “You don’t have to buy a car”.
scenes.say: We must act now. In many shops, you have to pay for plastic bags. You mustn't drop litter, because it's illegal. But you don't have to buy a car; you can walk or cycle.
scenes.say_uz: Biz hoziroq harakat qilishimiz kerak. Ko‘p do‘konlarda plastik paket uchun to‘lashingiz kerak. Chiqindi tashlamang, chunki bu noqonuniy. Lekin mashina sotib olishingiz shart emas; piyoda yoki velosipedda yurishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Modal fe’l xatolari
board: ✗ We should to recycle. → ✓ We should recycle.
✗ You don't must drop litter. → ✓ You mustn't …
✗ You mustn't come = shart emas → ✓ You don't have to come
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “should to recycle”. Modal fe’ldan keyin “to” qo‘yilmaydi. Ikkinchisi: “don’t must”. Modal fe’l inkorini “do” bilan yasamaymiz: “mustn’t”. Uchinchisi eng xavfli: “mustn’t” ni “shart emas” ma’nosida ishlatish. “You mustn’t come” — “kelishingiz mumkin emas”, “You don’t have to come”
scenes.say: Say we should recycle, not should to recycle. You mustn't drop litter means it's forbidden. You don't have to come means it isn't necessary.
scenes.say_uz: Should to recycle demang, we should recycle deng. You mustn't drop litter taqiqlanganini bildiradi. You don't have to come shart emasligini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Must, mustn't yoki don't have to?
board: 1) You ___ throw litter on the street. (taqiq)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring: mustn’t, don’t have to, must yoki should. Birinchisida taqiq bor. Ikkinchisida shart emas degan ma’no bor, shuning uchun qutiga tashlashdan oldin shishani yuvish shart emas. Uchinchisida kuchli shaxsiy fikr. To‘rtinchisi savol va maslahat so‘ramoqda. Har birini baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: you what throw litter on the street? Number two: you what wash the bottle? Number three: we what protect forests? Number four: what what we do?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: ko‘chaga chiqindi tashlash mumkin emasmi? Ikkinchi: shishani yuvish shart emasmi? Uchinchi: o‘rmonlarni himoya qilishimiz kerakmi? To‘rtinchi: biz nima qilishimiz kerak?

scenes.title: Modal fe’l javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “You mustn’t throw litter on the street”, bu taqiq. Ikkinchi: “You don’t have to wash the bottle”, bu shart emasligini bildiradi, lekin yuvsangiz ham bo‘ladi. Uchinchi: “We must protect forests”, kuchli fikr. To‘rtinchi: “What should we do?”, maslahat so‘rash. Savolning to‘rtinchi gapida “should”
scenes.say: One: mustn't. Two: don't have to. Three: must. Four: should.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: mustn't. Ikki: don't have to. Uch: must. To‘rt: should.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda modal fe’llar zaif aytiladi. “Should” gap o‘rtasida “shəd” bo‘ladi, “l” harfi umuman yo‘q, urg‘u esa keyingi muhim so‘zda: “We should RECYCLE”. “Must” ham “məst” kabi qisqa. Inkor shakli “mustn’t” esa to‘liq va kuchli aytiladi: “MUS-nt”, ichidagi “t” aytilmaydi. Shuning uchun “You mustn’t”
scenes.say: We should recycle. You must be careful. You mustn't drop litter. Notice that should and must are weak, but mustn't is strong and clear.
scenes.say_uz: Biz qayta ishlashimiz kerak. Ehtiyot bo‘lishingiz kerak. Chiqindi tashlamang. E’tibor bering, should va must zaif, mustn’t esa kuchli va aniq.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirish iboralari
board: In my opinion, … · I strongly believe that …
I'm worried about … · I'm afraid that …
I agree / I don't agree because …

examples.t: In my opinion, we should ban plastic bags.

scenes.say_native: Muhokamada o‘z fikringizni tayyor iboralar bilan bildiring. “In my opinion” — menimcha, “I strongly believe that” — chin dildan ishonamanki. Xavotirni “I’m worried about” va ot yoki “-ing” bilan aytasiz: “I’m worried about pollution”. Rozilik uchun “I agree”, norozilik uchun “I don’t agree, because…”. “I am agree” xato: “agree” fe’l, shuning uchun “be” kerak emas.
scenes.say: In my opinion, we should ban plastic bags. I'm worried about pollution, and I strongly believe that everyone can help. Do you agree?
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, plastik paketlarni taqiqlash kerak. Men ifloslanishdan xavotirdaman va hamma yordam bera olishiga qattiq ishonaman. Siz rozimisiz?

scenes.title: Sabab: because, since, because of

examples.t: Many animals are dying because their habitat is disappearing.
examples.uz: Ko‘p hayvonlar yashash joyi yo‘qolayotgani uchun o‘lmoqda.

examples.t: Flights were cancelled because of the storm.

scenes.say_native: Endi sabab-natija. Sabab uchun “because”, “since” va “as” dan keyin to‘liq gap, ya’ni ega va fe’l keladi: “because their habitat is disappearing”. “Because of” va “due to” dan keyin esa ot yoki ot guruhi: “because of the storm”, “due to pollution”. “Since” va “as” ko‘pincha gap boshida, sabab o‘quvchiga ma’lum bo‘lganda ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Many animals are dying because their habitat is disappearing. Some cities have bad air because of traffic. Since the climate is changing, we must act. Due to pollution, the water isn't safe.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p hayvonlar yashash joyi yo‘qolayotgani uchun o‘lmoqda. Ba’zi shaharlarda transport sababli havo yomon. Iqlim o‘zgarayotgani uchun biz harakat qilishimiz kerak. Ifloslanish sababli suv xavfsiz emas.

scenes.title: Natija: so, therefore, lead to
board: X leads to / results in / causes Y

examples.t: The factory closed, so many people lost their jobs.
examples.uz: Zavod yopildi, shuning uchun ko‘p odam ishdan ayrildi.

examples.t: Deforestation leads to a loss of habitat.
examples.uz: O‘rmonlarning kesilishi yashash joyining yo‘qolishiga olib keladi.

scenes.say_native: Natija uchun “so” — oddiy, og‘zaki: “It was hot, so we stayed inside”. “Therefore” va “as a result” yozma va rasmiyroq, ular gap boshida keladi va vergul bilan ajratiladi: “As a result, many farmers lost their crops”. Fe’llar: “lead to”, “result in” — keyin ot yoki “-ing” keladi; “cause” — keyin ham ot.
scenes.say: Burning fossil fuels causes air pollution. As a result, many people have breathing problems. Deforestation leads to the loss of habitat, so some species may disappear. Therefore, we must act now.
scenes.say_uz: Qazilma yoqilg‘ini yoqish havoning ifloslanishiga sabab bo‘ladi. Natijada ko‘p odamlarda nafas olish muammolari bor. O‘rmonlarning kesilishi yashash joyining yo‘qolishiga olib keladi, shuning uchun ba’zi turlar yo‘q bo‘lib ketishi mumkin. Shuning uchun biz hoziroq harakat qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Sabab-natija xatolari
board: ✗ because of it is hot → ✓ because it is hot
✗ leads to reduce → ✓ leads to a reduction / to reducing
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “because of” dan keyin gap qo‘yish, masalan “because of it is hot”. To‘g‘risi: “because it is hot” yoki “because of the heat”. Ikkinchisi: “Because it rained, so we stayed home”. O‘zbekchada “chunki… shuning uchun” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa “because” va “so” bir gapda ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Because it rained, we stayed home. It rained, so we stayed home. We use because or so, not both. And because of is followed by a noun.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘gani uchun uyda qoldik. Yomg‘ir yog‘di, shuning uchun uyda qoldik. Because yoki so ishlatamiz, ikkalasini emas. Because of dan keyin ot keladi.

scenes.title: Sabab-natijani bog‘lang
board: 1) Cars give off gases. ___ the air is dirty. (as a result / because)
2) The air is dirty ___ traffic. (because / because of)
3) Too much plastic ___ pollution in the sea. (leads to / leads)
4) It rained a lot, ___ rivers flooded. (so / because)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap bor, har birida ikki variantdan to‘g‘risini tanlang. Birinchi gap natijani gap boshida bildiradi. Ikkinchida “traffic” bu ot, gap emas. Uchinchida “to” predlog kerak. To‘rtinchida natija so‘z kerak. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq o‘qing.
scenes.say: Number one: as a result or because? Number two: because or because of? Number three: leads to or leads? Number four: so or because?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: as a result yoki because? Ikkinchi: because yoki because of? Uchinchi: leads to yoki leads? To‘rtinchi: so yoki because?

scenes.title: Bog‘lovchilar javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Cars give off gases. As a result, the air is dirty”. Ikkinchi: “because of traffic”, chunki “traffic” ot. Uchinchi: “Too much plastic leads to pollution in the sea”. To‘rtinchi: “It rained a lot, so rivers flooded”. Gap boshidagi “As a result” dan keyin vergul qo‘yilishini unutmang.
scenes.say: One: As a result. Two: because of. Three: leads to. Four: so.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: As a result. Ikki: because of. Uch: leads to. To‘rt: so.

scenes.title: Tinglash: maktabda taqdimot
board: Student presentation: plastic in the sea
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Maktabda bir talaba plastik chiqindi haqida qisqa taqdimot qilmoqda. Unda siz o‘rgangan bog‘lovchilar va modal fe’llarni eshitasiz. Tinglang: asosiy muammo nima, uning sababi nima, natijasi nima va talaba qanday yechim taklif qiladi.
scenes.say: Student: Good morning. The main problem is plastic in the sea. We throw away millions of bags, and many end up in the water. As a result, fish and birds die. One solution is to use cloth bags. Shops should charge for plastic bags, and we must recycle more. If everyone helps, the sea will be cleaner.
scenes.say_uz: Talaba: Xayrli tong. Asosiy muammo dengizdagi plastik. Biz millionlab paketlarni tashlaymiz va ko‘pchiligi suvga tushadi. Natijada baliq va qushlar o‘ladi. Yechimlardan biri mato sumkalardan foydalanish. Do‘konlar plastik paket uchun pul olishi kerak va biz ko‘proq qayta ishlashimiz kerak. Agar hamma yordam bersa, dengiz tozaroq bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Taqdimot bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) What happens to fish and birds?
scenes.say_native: Taqdimotni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: asosiy muammo nima? Ikkinchi: baliq va qushlarga nima bo‘ladi va nega? Uchinchi: do‘konlar nima qilishi kerak? Javobingizda “because” yoki “as a result” ni ishlatishga harakat qiling. To‘liq gap bilan, baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: What is the main problem? What happens to fish and birds? What should shops do?
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy muammo nima? Baliq va qushlarga nima bo‘ladi? Do‘konlar nima qilishi kerak?

scenes.title: Taqdimot javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: asosiy muammo dengizdagi plastik. Ikkinchi: baliq va qushlar o‘ladi, chunki plastik suvga tushadi, ya’ni “As a result, fish and birds die”. Uchinchi: do‘konlar plastik paket uchun pul olishi kerak, “Shops should charge for plastic bags”. E’tibor bering, talaba taqdimotni muammo, sabab, natija, yechim tartibida tuzdi.
scenes.say: The main problem is plastic in the sea. As a result, fish and birds die. Shops should charge for plastic bags.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy muammo dengizdagi plastik. Natijada baliq va qushlar o‘ladi. Do‘konlar plastik paket uchun pul olishi kerak.

scenes.title: Artikl: the environment, the planet
board: the environment · the planet · the climate · the sea
nature · pollution · plastic · climate change (no article)
a problem · an effect · a solution

examples.t: We must protect the environment.
Plastic is a big problem for nature.

scenes.say_native: Ekologiya mavzusida artikl ko‘p xato keltiradi. Yagona narsalar uchun “the”: “the environment”, “the planet”, “the climate”, “the sea”, “the sun”. Umumiy, sanalmaydigan tushunchalar artiklsiz: “nature”, “pollution”, “plastic”, “climate change”. Birinchi marta aytilgan sanaladigan ot bilan “a” yoki “an”: “a problem”, “an effect”, “a solution”.
scenes.say: We must protect the environment and the planet. Nature needs our help. Plastic is a big problem, and pollution has an effect on the sea.
scenes.say_uz: Biz atrof-muhitni va sayyorani himoya qilishimiz kerak. Tabiat bizning yordamimizga muhtoj. Plastik katta muammo, ifloslanish esa dengizga ta’sir qiladi.

scenes.title: Artikl kerakmi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda artikl kerakmi, kerak bo‘lsa qaysi biri: “the”, “a” yoki hech qaysi? Birinchi gap ifloslanish haqida umumiy gap. Ikkinchi gapda bizning yagona sayyoramiz haqida. Uchinchi gap tabiat haqida umumiy. To‘rtinchi gapda yaxshi yechim, birinchi marta tilga olinmoqda. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: what pollution is a global problem? Number two: we must protect what planet. Number three: what nature is beautiful. Number four: that is what good solution.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: ifloslanish global muammomi? Ikkinchi: sayyorani himoya qilishimiz kerak. Uchinchi: tabiat go‘zalmi? To‘rtinchi: bu yaxshi yechim.

scenes.title: Artikl javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Pollution is a global problem”, artikl yo‘q. Ikkinchi: “We must protect the planet”, chunki yagona sayyora. Uchinchi: “Nature is beautiful”, artikl yo‘q. To‘rtinchi: “That is a good solution”, bu yerda “a”, chunki yechim sanaladigan ot va birinchi marta aytilmoqda. Agar hammasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, ekologik gaplaringiz artikl jihatidan ishonchli eshitiladi.
scenes.say: One: no article. Two: the planet. Three: no article. Four: a good solution.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: artikl yo‘q. Ikki: the planet. Uch: artikl yo‘q. To‘rt: a good solution.

scenes.title: Uch muammo, uch yechim
board: One solution is to … · We should … · As a result …
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy vazifa: bir daqiqa gapiring. Uchta ekologik muammoni tanlang, masalan plastik, havoning ifloslanishi va o‘rmonlarning kesilishi. Har biri uchun muammo, sabab, natija va yechimni ayting. Quyidagi qoliplardan foydalaning: “One solution is to…”, “We should…”, “As a result…”. Kamida bitta “must” yoki “mustn’t” ham qo‘shing. Boshlang!
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Choose three environmental problems. For each one, give the cause, the effect and a solution. Speak for one minute.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Uchta ekologik muammoni tanlang. Har biri uchun sababni, natijani va yechimni ayting. Bir daqiqa gapiring.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: One solution is to … · As a result …
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang. Unda har bir muammo uchun sabab, natija va yechim bor, shuningdek “must”, “should” va bog‘lovchilar. Siz ham o‘z javobingizni shu mezonlar bilan tekshiring: uchta muammo bormi, har biri uchun yechim aytildimi, “because” yoki “as a result” ishlatildimi, modal fe’l to‘g‘ri qo‘llandimi.
scenes.say: First, plastic. We throw away too much, so it ends up in the sea. One solution is to use cloth bags. Second, air pollution. Cars give off gases, and as a result people get ill. We should use public transport. Third, deforestation.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi, plastik. Biz juda ko‘p tashlaymiz, shuning uchun u dengizga tushadi. Yechim mato sumkalardan foydalanish. Ikkinchi, havoning ifloslanishi. Mashinalar gaz chiqaradi, natijada odamlar kasal bo‘ladi. Jamoat transportidan foydalanishimiz kerak. Uchinchi, o‘rmonlarning kesilishi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: environment · pollution · recycle · cut down on
The main problem is … · One solution is to …
should / must / mustn't / don't have to
because (of) · so · as a result · lead to
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Atrof-muhit lug‘atini, “run out of” va “cut down on” kabi frazali fe’llarni o‘rgandik. Muammolarni “The main problem is…” bilan, yechimlarni “One solution is to…” va “If we…, we will…” bilan tasvirladik. “Should”, “must”, “mustn’t” va “don’t have to” farqini ko‘rdik. Sabab va natijani “because”, “because of”, “so”, “as a result”, “lead to” bilan bog‘ladik. Artikl qoidasini ham mustahkamladik.
scenes.say: Great work today! You can now talk about environmental problems, suggest solutions, say what people should and must do, and link causes with effects.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun zo‘r ishladingiz! Endi ekologik muammolar haqida gapira olasiz, yechimlar taklif qilasiz, odamlar nima qilishi kerakligini aytasiz va sabablarni natijalar bilan bog‘laysiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: about 2 minutes, speak or write 150 words
problem + cause + solution each · should / must · 2 linkers
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Uchta ekologik muammo va ularning yechimlarini taqdim eting: ikki daqiqa gapiring yoki taxminan yuz ellik so‘z yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir muammo uchun sabab va yechim bo‘lsin, “should” yoki “must” kamida ikki marta to‘g‘ri ishlatilsin, hamda kamida ikkita sabab-natija bog‘lovchisi, masalan “because of” va “as a result” bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda ko‘chirma gap asoslarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to present three environmental problems and their solutions. Use should or must, and at least two cause and effect linkers. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: uchta ekologik muammo va ularning yechimlarini taqdim eting. Should yoki must dan va kamida ikkita sabab-natija bog‘lovchisidan foydalaning. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Uchta ekologik muammo va ularning yechimlarini taqdim eting (2 daqiqa gapiring yoki taxminan 150 so‘z yozing). Mezon: har bir muammo uchun sabab va yechim, should yoki must kamida 2 marta, hamda kamida 2 ta sabab-natija bog‘lovchisi (because of, as a result).

quiz.q: Please put your rubbish ___ the bin.
quiz.why_uz: “In the bin” yoki “into the bin”. O‘zbekcha “ga” ta’sirida “to” deyish xato.

quiz.q: Choose the correct phrasal verb: We should ___ plastic.
quiz.why_uz: Kamaytirmoq — “cut down on”; “cut down” esa daraxt kesishda.

quiz.q: This is the solution ___ the problem.

quiz.why_uz: Modal fe’ldan keyin “to” siz fe’l shakli keladi.

quiz.q: You ___ drop litter. It is illegal.
quiz.why_uz: “Mustn’t” taqiqni bildiradi; “don’t have to” esa shart emasligini.

quiz.q: You ___ buy a car. You can take the bus.
quiz.why_uz: “Don’t have to” — shart emas, ya’ni majburiyat yo‘q.
“Because of” dan keyin ot keladi: traffic.

options: Because it rained, so we stayed in.
Because it rained, we stayed in.
It rained because so we stayed in.
Because of it rained, we stayed in.
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida “because” va “so” bir gapda birga ishlatilmaydi.
